style: Stylized heroic fantasy painting in the look of a hand-painted 2D animated fantasy cinematic short: bold simplified shapes, slightly heroic sturdy proportions (broad shoulders, solid armour and props), heavy confident painterly brush strokes, hand-painted textures, rich saturated colour with a limited palette per scene, strong warm rim light against deep cool shadows, big areas of calm empty darkness, atmospheric haze between clear foreground, middle ground and background layers, cinematic widescreen composition. No ink outlines and no comic line art: edges are defined only by paint and light. Grounded anatomy and believable faces with real weight and emotion, semi-realistic like a painted cinematic short, not a cartoon, not a comic, not photorealistic, not a book illustration. Full-bleed image edge to edge: no black bars, no letterbox, no text, no letters, no logos, no borders, no frame, no watermark.

cast.lucien: Lucien Vale, a young half-elf wild magic sorcerer who loves to sing and play music, a good-hearted man who was betrayed: long straight blond hair, pointed elf ears, clean-shaven handsome face with fine elven features and a straight, slim, normal-sized nose, lively expressive eyes, burgundy velvet long coat with brass buttons over a dark shirt, leather belt with a dagger whose blade glows faintly blue, faint purple arcane sparks flickering at his fingertips, a wooden flute at his belt, slim build. His face is full of life and follows the scene: shouting, laughing, fierce, cocky, scheming, grieving only when the scene grieves. Sympathetic hero, never sinister or villainous
cast.drow: Nerrissa, a beautiful drow woman: dark purple-grey skin, long straight white hair, pointed ears, violet eyes, a fitted dark leather outfit with silver details, a sly smile, a monster hunter with two curved silver blades
cast.boy: Lucien as a small boy of about six, long ago: messy blond hair, small pointed elf ears, big blue-grey eyes, round cheeks, a plain linen shirt and little brown trousers, barefoot or in small boots
cast.father: Lucien's father, a tall slender man with an almost aristocratic bearing, HIS FACE IS NEVER SHOWN: always seen from behind or with the face lost in deep shadow; a long dark velvet-lined travel cloak with a jagged fur collar falling heavily to the floor, long pale fingers with scars over the knuckles, a heavy silver ring on the little finger, a dark wooden lute, a silver belt buckle shaped like a beast head with two red stone eyes
cast.buckle: AN OBJECT, NOT A PERSON (no people, no body, no wearer): the father's silver belt buckle on its own, shown three times: from the front, at an angle, and a close detail; a stylised wolf-like beast head with open jaws and two small dark red stones set in the eye sockets, old worn silver, on a short strip of dark leather belt
